correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the pointwise Delta criterion for finite ell-infinity sums using slices and the rank-one characterization, then proves both convex-hull directions. The converse uses finite Hahn--Banach separation and a single summed functional with a strict support gap. Quantifiers, active coordinates, inactive-coordinate distance margins, and the empty-Delta-set case are accounted for. No experiment replaces proof.

value.rationale: The theorem closes the exact exceptional norm singled out by a current paper and replaces a missing inheritance statement with a sharp logical classification: a finite ell-infinity sum has convex-DLD2P exactly when one factor does. This both supplies a reusable finite-sum criterion and explains why the excluded norm behaves qualitatively differently from every other absolute norm in the focal factor-inheritance theorem.
